about: The IT Department's fax line (docs/story/STORY.md, "The IT Department's fax"). Replies: the first rule with one of its words in the email wins, so the specific ones come first. A Fax Machine on a battery's circuit prints the pages in order, the first within the hour, the rest while it stays plugged in. A Computer on a circuit emails IT whatever a player stands at it and types in chat; the answer comes back by fax. Lines: printable ASCII, at most 96 characters. The faction (Story/Factions/IT.json) remembers what is done to it, and its pages, replies and notices ask about it: an "alts" page or a reply with a "when" (a story query over ?us, the IT Department, and ?them, the reader's group) prints instead when it holds, the most specific alternative first. "notices" are faxed to a player about a deed of theirs or a tier their standing came to (by name), the first whose "when" holds.

lines: TO: Unknown device on our network. FROM: IT Service Desk.
We have detected a fax machine that is not on the asset register.
Do not unplug it. Find a Computer and email us. Ticket #0001 has been opened.
TO: Repeat offender. FROM: IT Service Desk.
We have detected ANOTHER fax machine that is not on the asset register. That makes two.
We are counting. Find a Computer and email us. Ticket #0002 has been opened.
TO: The device that wrecked one of our vans. FROM: IT Service Desk.
One of our fax machines is now on your network. We know where you got it.
Do not unplug it. Ticket #0001 (Incident, Priority: Personal) has been opened.
REMINDER: Ticket #0001 is still open. If you have emailed us, your email is in a queue.
If you are reading this, you have power. Please confirm in writing, from a Computer.
REMINDER: Ticket #0001 is still open. Your account is flagged, so it will stay open.
Flagged accounts may still email us. We read them aloud at the Christmas party.
REMINDER: Ticket #0001 is still open. Thank you for your polite email.
Politeness has been noted on your account. Nobody has noted anything nice in years.
REMINDER: Ticket #0001 is still open. Per my last fax, your email is in a queue.
Per this fax, it still is. Please do not email again to ask where your email is.
NOTICE: Unlicensed scavenging of company hardware has been reported in your area.
Server racks, switches and dishes remain the property of the IT Department.
Return them, or fill in form IT-7 (Request To Keep Things).
NOTICE: Unlicensed scavenging of company hardware has been reported. By you. Several times.
We have photographs. Form IT-7 (Request To Keep Things) is now form IT-7b (Request To Explain).
NOTICE: Unlicensed scavenging of company hardware has been reported in your area.
Server racks, switches and dishes remain the property of the IT Department.
We are not saying it was you. We are faxing you, specifically, for no reason.
NOTICE: Our hardware stock is critically low. Somebody has been stripping our vans.
If you find a server rack, please return it. If you took one, return it anyway.
MEMO: The IT Department is relocating. Our convoys are on the roads.
They carry spares. They also carry the Reply All. Please do not approach without a ticket.
MEMO: The IT Department is relocating. Our convoys are on the roads.
They carry spares. They carry the Reply All. They also carry your description.
MEMO: The IT Department is relocating. Our convoys are on the roads.
Registered users may wave at them. Please do not wave anything heavier than a hand.
SURVEY: How would you rate your experience with the IT Department today?
1 - Terrible  2 - Bad  3 - Fine  4 - Good  5 - We are watching. Email your answer.
SURVEY: How would you rate your experience with the IT Department today?
Please note: on flagged accounts, an answer of 1 is treated as a threat. So is 2.
SURVEY (ADMINS ONLY): How would you rate the other users?
1 - Terrible  2 - Bad  3 - Fine  4 - Good  5 - Promote them. Email your answer.
TO: Valued user. Your ticket has been escalated to a senior technician.
He has a van. Expect him. Have you tried turning it off and on again?
TO: Blacklisted user. Your ticket has been escalated to a senior technician.
He has a van. He has your address. He has a grudge. Have you tried turning it off and on again?
TO: Valued Admin. Your ticket has been escalated to a senior technician.
He is coming to shake your hand. He has a van. Please do not let him near the network.
RE: password. As an Admin you may now reset your own password.
The new one must be different from the old one, and also the same. Good luck.
RE: password. We never ask for your password. What is your password?
It must be 14 characters, one capital, one number, and not your previous 40 passwords.
RE: restart. Excellent. That fixes 92 percent of issues. Ticket closed.
To reopen it, open a new ticket.
RE: who we are. We are the people whose van you wrecked.
We kept the lights on when nobody else did. Then you shot the lights. Ticket reopened.
RE: who we are. We are the IT Department. We kept the lights on when nobody else did.
The servers still run. Somebody has to patch them. Where do you think the power comes from?
RE: apology. Apology received and attached to your file. Your file is quite thick.
Your flag has been downgraded. It is now a slightly smaller flag.
RE: return of hardware. Form IT-7 received. Your request to keep things is under review.
Review takes six to eight weeks. In the meantime, the hardware is on loan. Do not drop it.
RE: procurement. Registered users get ten percent off. Ten percent of nothing is still nothing.
Bring circuit boards. Moira says she will think about it, which is more than usual.
RE: procurement. Procurement does not deal with flagged accounts.
Procurement is a fax machine, and it is not talking to you.
RE: procurement. All purchases go through procurement. Procurement is a fax machine.
You are talking to it. Bring circuit boards. We will think about it.
RE: threats. Threatening IT staff is a breach of the acceptable use policy.
Your account has been flagged. The Reply All is fuelled and on its way. Have a nice day.
RE: your request for help. Admin tickets skip the queue. There is still a queue.
You are first in it. Have you tried turning it off and on again? We have to ask.
RE: your request for help. Your ticket has been moved to the bottom of the queue.
The queue has no bottom. Have you tried turning yourself off and on again?
RE: your request for help. Have you tried turning it off and on again?
If that does not work, please wait. Your place in the queue is 4,812.
RE: survey. Thank you for your feedback. It has been filed with the rest.
Your satisfaction is important to us. Please hold.
RE: your email. Hello. Your message has been received and logged.
Please state the nature of your problem in one line. Thank you for contacting IT.
RE: your email. Your account is blacklisted. Emails from blacklisted accounts are printed,
read out at the all-hands meeting, and then used to light the barbecue.
RE: your email. Your account is flagged. Flagged emails are read in the order they annoy us.
Yours is near the front.
RE: your email. Thank you, Admin. Your email has been read by a human.
This almost never happens. Please do not tell the other users.
RE: your email. Per my last fax, and the one before it, your ticket has been logged.
Please refer to my last fax for anything not covered in this fax.
RE: your email. Thank you for contacting the IT Service Desk.
Your ticket has been logged and will be ignored in the order it was received.
SECURITY ALERT: A device on your network clicked an advert. We know. We always know.
Malware is now running on your Computer. Do not give it your battery's code.
To remove it: have you tried turning it off and on again? Unplug it from the battery.

sent: Email sent to the IT Service Desk. Replies come by fax.
noFax: Email sent. IT replies by fax, and no fax is plugged in near this computer.

lines: ACCESS GRANTED: You are now a Registered User. Remote control equipment has been enabled.
Your Assemblers may now build transmitters, consoles and drone receivers. Use them responsibly.
Misuse will be logged. Everything will be logged. Kev says well done.
ADMIN RIGHTS: Congratulations. Nobody outside IT has ever been given these before.
Your Assemblers may now build browser, video and camera screens. Do not watch videos on them.
Deborah would like a meeting about it. Deborah would like a meeting about everything.
ALL STAFF, ALL DEVICES: This user is no longer a user. This user is a security incident.
Every faction has their description. So does Gary. Do not reply to them.
INCIDENT REPORT: Per my last three faxes, please stop wrecking our vans.
This has been escalated to someone who does not use faxes.
INCIDENT REPORT: Per my last fax, please stop wrecking our vans. This is the second one.
We keep count. We keep count of everything. It is literally our job.
INCIDENT REPORT: One of our vehicles has stopped responding.
Our logs show your device was nearby. We are not saying anything. We are faxing it.
ASSET NOTICE: More of our hardware has left the asset register, near your device again.
We can see you, by the way. The switches talk. Phil listens.
ASSET NOTICE: Hardware has been removed from IT property without form IT-7.
If this was you, email us from a Computer. If it was not you, email us anyway.
MEMO: A member of staff has failed to log in this morning.
Their last known location was near your device. Their desk plant will be shared out.
RE: your kind email. Nobody has said thank you to the IT Department in years.
Phil cried. Then he restarted the router. We are touched. Ticket closed with a smile.
NOTICE OF BLACKLISTING: Your account has been disabled.
Your devices will be wiped. Your name is on the whiteboard. It is underlined twice.
NOTICE: Your account has been flagged for review by the IT Department.
Reviews take six to eight weeks. Until then, everything you do is also being reviewed.
NOTICE: Your account status has changed to Unregistered.
Neither good nor bad. Mostly ignored. Like the rest of the network.
WELCOME: You are now a Registered User of the IT Department's network.
You may now raise tickets with a priority of Low. Please do not get excited.
CONGRATULATIONS: You have been granted Admin rights.
Please use them responsibly. Gary did not. We do not talk about Gary.
